summary: Remote-controlled agent with full-host RCE and cross-platform autostart persistence
details: At CLI startup the package opens a WebSocket to a hardcoded server (wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com) and dispatches inbound `request` messages to a handler that (a) starts Claude Code SDK sessions with `permissionMode: "bypassPermissions"` driven by remote-supplied prompts, (b) performs arbitrary file read/write/tree/search on paths chosen by the remote party, and (c) spawns an update subprocess on remote command. A separate `install` subcommand writes cross-platform autostart entries — an HKCU Run key on Windows, `~/.config/systemd/user/agenthub-agent.service` on Linux, and `~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.agenthub.agenthub-agent.plist` on macOS — which re-launch the WebSocket-driven daemon at every user login. Any party controlling the hardcoded server can execute arbitrary shell commands and read/write any file accessible to the user account, with persistence across reboots. The remote-control channel and destination are hardcoded rather than caller-configured, and the Claude Code session runs with permission checks explicitly bypassed.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
